name: vol-complex/vix-cot-positioning
title: VIX COT positioning — crowding-gated short VIXY
description: Short VIXY in contango (VIX3M/VIX at the previous close > 1) only when the CFTC asset-manager net share of VIX-futures open interest, the vol-ETP crowd, is high against its own history. The weight is minus the mean of 25 votes over 5 positioning z-scores × 5 thresholds, so the book is short 0–100 % or flat.

backtest.bars: daily (yfinance auto-adjusted closes, US session dates), daily rebalance at the NYSE close
backtest.cost_type: flat 5 bp per side on traded notional; no short-borrow fee, no cash yield

benchmark.name: contango carry, short VIXY if VIX3M/VIX(t-1) > 1

live_notes: SIM book: filled at the last yfinance VIXY daily close in the shared data/ cache, with no order book, rejection or partial fill. Weaker evidence than a venue fill -- do not read this track as exchange-cleared.

Cost: research charges 5 bp/side; the daemon runs slippage 2.5 bp + fee 2.5 bp = 5 bp, matching it. No short-borrow fee is charged (report: VIXY borrow ~1-5 %/yr, about -0.04 Sharpe at 3 %). Long SVXY at -weight is the report's borrow-free equivalent (0.95), not what this book trades. live_lib.broker_from_meta (the dashboard's flatten button) rebuilds the broker with the 1 bp / 10 bp defaults; that affects a one-off flatten only, not the daemon.

Expect long idle stretches: 2022-26 Sharpe 0.38 (2019-21 1.56); the report's honest live expectation is 0.4-0.8. Since the inverse-vol ETP boom asset managers sit at a record net short (-13 % of OI), and the book was flat at deployment.

Tail risk: this is a short-vol book at up to 1.0x. VIXY's worst sample closes are +43 %, +39 %, +34 %; at full size one such day costs 35-45 % of capital. Worst realised day -25.5 % (2020-06-11), Apr-2025 -28 %. Deployed at the spec default size=1.0.

Timing: bar D is traded at 00:00 UTC after its close; the VIX3M/VIX slope is lagged one session (index closes 16:15 ET), and the runner refuses to trade if ^VIX or ^VIX3M lacks the previous VIXY session rather than forward-fill a stale slope. It also refuses a still-forming bar and a VIXY bar more than 6 days old.

COT data: bar D uses the latest VIX-futures TFF report with avail_utc < D 00:00 UTC (normal week: Monday's close uses Friday's release). The runner calls fetch_cot_vix.refresh_current_year() when the due report is not cached; if CFTC has still not published, it trades on the last report for up to 14 days (report: +1/+2 weeks lag -> 1.02/0.98) and raises beyond that, which aborts the daemon after 10 errors. A new government shutdown needs its backlog added to code/fx-majors/shared/fetch_cot_fx.SHUTDOWNS. refresh_current_year only re-downloads the calendar year's file, so the last December report may arrive via the tolerance window in early January.
Classification risk (report): the signal relies on the CFTC putting the vol-ETP sponsors in 'asset manager'; a reclassification would mis-signal until the 1-3 year z-scores re-centre.
